```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "")
grr <- params$grr
fmt <- function(x, d = 3) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, digits = d, format = "f", decimal.mark = "."))
esc <- function(x) gsub("|", "\\|", x, fixed = TRUE)   # pipes break markdown tables
na_text <- "*Not assessed in this validation.*"
```

## 1. Context of use and model risk

| | |
|---|---|
| **Question of interest** | `r if (nzchar(params$question)) esc(params$question) else "*not stated*"` |
| **Context of use** | `r if (nzchar(params$cou)) esc(params$cou) else "*not stated*"` |
| **Model risk tier** | `r params$risk` (model influence x decision consequence) |
| **Acceptance criteria** | `r if (nzchar(params$acceptance)) esc(params$acceptance) else "*not stated*"` |

The pipeline under validation is treated as a measurement system. Its
precision is characterised by a crossed study (items x prompt variants x
models x replicates), its accuracy against a reference, its robustness by
a screening design, following the logic of AIAG MSA, CLSI EP05 and ICH
Q2(R2) and the risk-based credibility framework for AI models proposed by
the FDA (2025).

## 2. Study design as realised

```{r design, results='asis'}
n <- grr$n
cat(sprintf("%d items x %d prompt variants x %d models x %d block(s); %d valid observations; %d to %d valid replicates per cell.\n",
            n$items, n$prompts, n$models, n$blocks, n$observations, n$reps_per_cell[1], n$reps_per_cell[2]))
```

```{r counts}
if (!is.null(params$runs)) {
  cnt <- llmsa::msa_counts(params$runs)
  knitr::kable(cnt, caption = "Planned and valid responses per prompt variant and model.")
} else cat(na_text)
```

```{r counts-note, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$runs)) {
  r <- params$runs
  cat(sprintf("Backend errors: %d. Unparseable responses: %d. Cells with fewer than two valid replicates: %d.\n\n",
              if ("error" %in% names(r)) sum(!is.na(r$error)) else 0L,
              sum(is.na(r$value)), attr(cnt, "cells_under_two")))
}
```

## 3. Precision: gauge repeatability and reproducibility

```{r grr}
tab <- grr$table
tab$variance <- fmt(tab$variance, 4); tab$sd <- fmt(tab$sd, 4)
tab$pct_contribution <- fmt(tab$pct_contribution, 1); tab$pct_study_var <- fmt(tab$pct_study_var, 1)
names(tab) <- c("Source", "Variance", "SD", "% Contribution", "% Study variation")
knitr::kable(tab, align = "lrrrr",
             caption = sprintf("Variance components (%s outcome%s).", grr$type,
                               if (grr$type != "numeric") ", latent scale" else ""))
```

```{r grr-summary, results='asis'}
s <- grr$summary
cat(sprintf("* Total gauge R&R: **%.1f %% of study variation** (%.1f %% contribution)\n", s[["grr_pct_study_var"]], s[["grr_pct_contribution"]]))
cat(sprintf("* Repeatability %.1f %%, reproducibility %.1f %% of study variation\n", s[["repeatability_pct_study_var"]], s[["reproducibility_pct_study_var"]]))
if (grr$type != "numeric") cat("* On the latent scale, Repeatability is the residual variance fixed by the link, not a measurement of disagreement between replicates; see the share of cells with identical replicates from `msa_agreement()`.\n")
cat(sprintf("* Number of distinct categories (ndc): %s; ICC(items) = %.3f\n", format(s[["ndc"]]), s[["icc_items"]]))
cat(sprintf("* Classification: **%s** (basis %s, thresholds %g / %g)\n", toupper(grr$verdict),
            if (grr$basis == "study_var") "% study variation" else "% contribution", grr$threshold[1], grr$threshold[2]))
if (isTRUE(grr$singular)) cat("* Note: singular fit; at least one variance component was estimated at zero. With few prompt or model levels this is expected; see the bootstrap intervals.\n")
cat(sprintf("\nThe ndc calculation uses the constant %g, truncates to an integer and has a minimum of one.\n\n", params$ndc_constant))
cat(sprintf("The %%Contribution thresholds %g %% and %g %% are a convention, the squared study-variation thresholds, not thresholds specified in the AIAG handbook.\n\n", params$contribution_thresholds[1], params$contribution_thresholds[2]))
if (grr$type != "numeric") cat("The AIAG verdict thresholds on the latent scale are a convention.\n\n")
for (source in grr$derived) cat("The ", source, " component is derived from two fixed levels using the range method; see `msa_fit()` and the validation vignette for its limitations.\n\n", sep = "")
cat("The fitted model excludes block interactions and three-way interactions.\n\n")
```

```{r boot}
if (!is.null(params$boot)) {
  b <- as.data.frame(params$boot)
  b$estimate <- fmt(b$estimate, 2); b$lower <- fmt(b$lower, 2); b$upper <- fmt(b$upper, 2)
  knitr::kable(b, caption = sprintf("Parametric bootstrap, %d replicates, %.0f %% percentile intervals.",
                                    nrow(attr(params$boot, "boot")), 100 * attr(params$boot, "level")))
} else cat(na_text)
```

## 4. Agreement and accuracy

```{r agreement, results='asis'}
ag <- params$agreement
if (!is.null(ag)) {
  if (!is.null(params$assessment)) cat("Complete-case agreement diagnostics from msa_agreement(); application decision metrics and their missing-value rules are reported separately below.\n\n")
  cat("General agreement diagnostics omit missing answers. The modal response selects the lowest tied category in scale order; an item without valid answers has no mode. AP1 decision metrics use acmg_modal(), which treats missing answers as a category and excludes ties from decisions.\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("Categories: %s (weights: %s). %d items, %d responses, %d missing.\n\n",
              paste(ag$levels, collapse = " < "), ag$weights, ag$n[["items"]], ag$n[["responses"]], ag$n[["missing"]]))
  cat(sprintf("* Repeatability: %.1f %% of item-prompt-model cells have identical replicates\n", ag$repeatability_overall))
  r <- ag$reproducibility
  cat(sprintf("* Reproducibility: items consistent across prompts %.1f %%, across models %.1f %%, under all conditions %.1f %%\n", r[[1]], r[[2]], r[[3]]))
  if (!is.null(ag$fleiss)) cat(sprintf("* Fleiss' kappa: %.3f\n", ag$fleiss$kappa))
  if (!is.null(ag$accuracy)) {
    cat(sprintf("* Accuracy: %.1f %% of responses correct; %.1f %% of items correct in every call; Cohen's kappa (modal response vs reference) %.3f, (all responses vs reference) %.3f\n",
                ag$accuracy_overall, ag$pct_items_all_correct, ag$kappa[[1]], ag$kappa[[2]]))
  }
  cat("\n")
  al <- ag$alpha; al$alpha <- fmt(al$alpha, 3)
  print(knitr::kable(al, caption = "Krippendorff's alpha by scope."))
  if (!is.null(ag$accuracy)) {
    ac <- ag$accuracy; ac$pct_correct <- fmt(ac$pct_correct, 1)
    print(knitr::kable(ac, caption = "Percent correct per prompt variant and model."))
  }
} else cat(na_text)
```

## 5. Bias and linearity

```{r bias, results='asis'}
bi <- params$bias
if (!is.null(bi)) {
  o <- bi$overall
  cat(sprintf("Mean bias %.4f (%.0f %% CI %.4f to %.4f; sd %.4f; n = %d; p = %.3g). Linearity: bias = %.4f + %.4f x reference (slope p = %.3g).\n\n",
              o[["bias"]], 100 * bi$level, o[["lower"]], o[["upper"]], o[["sd"]], as.integer(o[["n"]]), o[["p_value"]],
              bi$linearity[["intercept"]], bi$linearity[["slope"]], bi$linearity[["slope_p_value"]]))
  excluded <- if ("n_excluded" %in% names(o)) format(o[["n_excluded"]], scientific = FALSE) else "not recorded"
  cat(sprintf("Valid response-reference pairs: %d; excluded: %s.\n\n", as.integer(o[["n"]]), excluded))
  bc <- bi$by_condition
  if (!"n_excluded" %in% names(bc)) bc$n_excluded <- "not recorded"
  for (nm in c("bias", "sd", "lower", "upper")) bc[[nm]] <- fmt(bc[[nm]], 4)
  bc$p_value <- formatC(bc$p_value, digits = 3, format = "g")
  print(knitr::kable(bc, caption = "Bias per prompt variant and model."))
  if (!is.null(bi$linearity_item_means)) {
    fields <- c("intercept", "slope", "r_squared", "t_intercept", "t_slope", "df")
    regressions <- data.frame(method = c("Handbook: all valid single values", "Unweighted item means"),
                              rbind(bi$linearity[fields], bi$linearity_item_means[fields]),
                              row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE)
    for (nm in setdiff(fields, "df")) regressions[[nm]] <- fmt(regressions[[nm]], 4)
    cat("\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(regressions, caption = "Linearity regressions; R-squared is a proportion."))
    cat(sprintf("\nHandbook t quantile: %.4f.\n\n", bi$linearity[["t_quantile"]]))
  }
  verdict <- bi$linearity_verdict
  if (is.null(verdict)) verdict <- "not recorded" else if (is.na(verdict)) verdict <- "undetermined"
  cat(sprintf("\nHandbook linearity verdict: **%s**. Zero must lie in the confidence band throughout the observed reference range.\n\n", verdict))
  if (!is.null(bi$linearity_note)) cat(bi$linearity_note, "\n\n")
  if (!is.null(bi$linearity_band) && nrow(bi$linearity_band)) {
    band <- bi$linearity_band
    for (nm in names(band)) band[[nm]] <- fmt(band[[nm]], 4)
    print(knitr::kable(band, caption = "Handbook confidence band for the mean bias (not a prediction interval)."))
  }
} else cat(na_text)
```

## 6. Robustness

```{r robustness, results='asis'}
ro <- params$robustness
if (!is.null(ro)) {
  me <- formatC(attr(ro, "me"), format = "f", digits = 4)
  cat(sprintf("Screening design with %d runs and %d factors; response mean %.4f (sd %.4f). Lenth PSE %.4f, ME %s, SME %.4f.\n\n",
              attr(ro, "n_runs"), nrow(ro), attr(ro, "response_mean"), attr(ro, "response_sd"),
              attr(ro, "pse"), me, attr(ro, "sme")))
  d <- as.data.frame(ro); d$effect <- fmt(d$effect, 4); d$t_lenth <- fmt(d$t_lenth, 2)
  print(knitr::kable(d, caption = "Main effects of the screened perturbations."))
  if (any(ro$active)) {
    factors <- paste0(ro$factor[ro$active], " (",
      ifelse(ro$active_simultaneous[ro$active], "also above SME", "above ME only"), ")")
    cat(sprintf("\nActive factors: **%s**. The pipeline is sensitive to these perturbations and the procedure must control them.\n", paste(factors, collapse = ", ")))
  } else {
    cat("\nNo factor exceeded the margin of error (ME = ", me,
        "). Smaller effects cannot be told apart from noise with this design, so this result does not show that the pipeline is robust.\n", sep = "")
  }
} else cat(na_text)
```

```{r robustness-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Half-normal plot of robustness effects"}
if (!is.null(params$assessment) && !is.null(params$robustness)) plot(params$robustness)
```

## 7. System suitability: Westgard control chart

```{r control-chart, results='asis'}
if (is.null(params$control_chart)) {
  cat(na_text)
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(params$control_chart, row.names = FALSE))
  if (params$control_chart_reading == "range") {
    cat("\n\nR_4s uses the range of two consecutive standardized values.\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n\nR_4s uses the Westgard reading: one of two consecutive standardized values is above 2 and the other below -2.\n")
  }
}
```

## 8. Conclusion

```{r conclusion, results='asis'}
if (is.null(params$assessment)) {
cat(sprintf("Measured against the acceptance criteria (%s), the precision study classifies the pipeline as **%s** for the stated context of use at model risk tier *%s*. ",
            if (nzchar(params$acceptance)) params$acceptance else "not stated", toupper(grr$verdict), params$risk))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Measured against all stated acceptance criteria, the overall verdict is **%s** for the stated context of use at model risk tier *%s*. ",
              toupper(params$assessment$verdict), params$risk))
}
cat("The verdict applies to the model snapshots, prompts and parsing used in this study; a change to any of them requires re-validation, and a system-suitability control set should be run before every productive batch (see `msa_control_chart()`).\n")
```

```{r assessment, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$assessment)) {
  cat("\n### Assessment by criterion\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(params$assessment$criteria, row.names = FALSE))
  for (nm in names(params$assessment$sections)) {
    s <- params$assessment$sections[[nm]]
    cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n", paste(s$text, collapse = "\n\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (!is.null(s$table)) print(knitr::kable(s$table, row.names = FALSE))
  }
}
```

## 9. Traceability

| | |
|---|---|
| Rendered | `r params$rendered_at` |
| llmsa version | `r params$package_version` |
| R version | `r R.version.string` |
| lme4 / ordinal | `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("lme4"))` / `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("ordinal"))` |
| Data hash (SHA-256 of the canonical run table) | `r if (is.na(params$data_hash)) "not available (runs not supplied)" else params$data_hash` |

Design seed: `r params$design_seed`

Bootstrap seed: `r params$bootstrap_seed`

Plackett-Burman seed: `r params$plackett_burman_seed`

```{r model-metadata, results='asis'}
if (nrow(params$model_metadata)) {
  models <- params$model_metadata
  models[] <- lapply(models, esc)
  print(knitr::kable(models, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\nModel and Provider list all observed response metadata. Quantization lists requested routing settings recorded in meta; it is not a provider attestation. Missing values are not reported.\n\n")
  if (length(params$metadata_notes)) cat(paste(esc(params$metadata_notes), collapse = "\n\n"), "\n\n")
} else cat("Model metadata: not reported (no run rows supplied).\n\n")
```
